_comment: Phase-3 WP6 transition reset/ownership across EVERY stage (LEVEL01 alone cannot show whether the laws are general). Poll-only over from-boot movies — watches during playback desync the replay. Regenerate: tools/phase3_transition_reset.py --all.

load_gap_frames._comment: frames between the scene id flipping and the world actually existing — a mod hooking 'scene changed' runs inside an EMPTY world for this long

entry_load.note: the scene-id flip lies in the <=30-frame scene_id_flip_bracket; scene_id_flip_frame is its upper sample. The WORLD (actors, player) only exists at world_ready_frame — the gap is the disc load. A mod hooking 'scene changed' runs during an EMPTY world.

exit_to_shell.note: sampled the tick before the flip vs settled after it
